name: Kageriyuku Kyoushitsu
source:
Main character is raised by the brother. He looks up to his brother, so after graduating chooses the same school for practice where brother works as a teacher. He starts to get accustomed to it. But one day protagonist becomes boycotted by students of his class over a trivial reason...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-november-2005-sharin-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角由哥哥撫養長大，一直十分仰慕他。因此畢業後，主角選擇到哥哥任教的同一所學校實習，並逐漸適應那裡的生活。然而一天，他卻因為一件微不足道的小事遭到班上學生集體排擠……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-november-2005-sharin-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
